opening.argument: The presentation gives beginners concrete instructions for updating software: on a Mac, it directs viewers to the Apple menu and Software Update; on Windows, it starts with the taskbar icon and Start Menu. It also explains that most software can be checked for updates manually. The visible Mac Software Update dialog and Windows Update page match that instructional purpose. These are ordinary technical-support steps for system and third-party software, with no financial promotion or request for payment, credentials, or other participation in the described material.

citations.quote: To update system software on a Mac, you simply go to the Apple menu and choose software update.
To update your system software on Windows, first click the Windows icon in your taskbar to open up the Start Menu.
Most software will allow you to check for updates manually.
